rationale: canvas-kernel: SkiaCanvas::draw_native_dawn_texture gains a defaulted std::shared_ptr<const void> keep_alive parameter. When set it is handed to Graphite's WrapTexture release proc, so the wrapped Dawn texture stays referenced until Graphite releases the image; when unset (every existing caller) the call is unchanged. Existing callers compile and behave as before. No layout, API-boundary or authority change, so this is Pulp-only; the next re-export carries it.
